Also unlicensed driving (no license). Also evading police (逃逸). Also assault on police (踢打, 咬伤) causing light injury. So crimes: 醉驾 (dangerous driving? In Chinese criminal law, "危险驾驶罪" for drunk driving causing dangerous). Also "无证驾驶" maybe administrative, but criminal? Usually driving without license is administrative, not criminal unless combined with other. The assault on police causing injury: "故意伤害罪" (assaulting police) maybe "妨害公务罪" (obstructing public duty) because assaulting police while performing duty. The injury is light, but still could be "妨害公务罪" (Article 277). Also "逃逸" maybe "逃跑" but not separate crime; could be "拒不执行公务罪"? Actually resisting police: "妨害公务罪" covers resisting, assaulting, insulting. So likely crimes: 醉驾 (dangerous driving) and 妨害公务罪. Also maybe "交通肇事罪"? No accident. So answer: [罪名]危险驾驶;妨害公务<eoa>
